answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed actions are later proven fraudulent, and release it only after a long challenge window. One person can still mint many identities, but each must lock real capital; flooding the graph with vertex accounts multiplies the stake at risk rather than creating free influence. A glacier-paced withdrawal delay also prevents attackers from cashing out before evidence arrives, so a cheap sybil spiral becomes a costly, exposed bet.
